spatial_l1_scope: Exploratory absolute full-domain density error screen at the AV06 tolerance magnitude. It is a separate endpoint criterion, not AV06, a bound on interpolation error, or physical validation.

spatial_method.domain: Center-align both cells, use the reference sample grid in the smaller cell and separately count the absolute reference density outside it. The outside contribution measures excluded reference mass, not a computed candidate field.
spatial_method.same_step: Compare the aligned original samples directly.
spatial_method.different_step: Evaluate the candidate at reference points by separable four-point and six-point Lagrange interpolation with one-sided edge support. Report both and require both padded-domain L1 results to meet the threshold.
spatial_method.weight: Use the nominal reference cell length divided by its sample count after confirming the rounded native axes against CP2K's locked units.
spatial_method.samples: Use full signed STRIDE 1 values. No clipping, fitted alignment, density renormalization or extrapolation outside the smaller physical cell.

limits: One fixed H2 geometry and one locked x86 CP2K/PBE/GAPW/cc-pVDZ setup.
The 20 angstrom result is a comparison reference, not a converged continuum solution.
The 12 angstrom endpoint changes the cell, CUTOFF and REL_CUTOFF together. AV03 family refinement, AV04 basis convergence, and complete AV05/AV06 acceptance are separate.
The density threshold is defined before measuring cross-grid differences and is limited to this engineering screen.
No production OCI or physical validation.
